analyst.text: Both teams are coming off embarrassments. New Orleans lost by 51 at Golden State, the worst regular-season loss in franchise history, and Jamahl Mosley said bluntly they got their "tail kicked". Brooklyn are rebuilding at 2-8 after a 37-point loss in Dallas, and Moritz Wagner questioned the team's maturity. Egor Demin is now probable after six missed games. The lean goes to a bounce-back from New Orleans at home with Zion Williamson and Trey Murphy III back from rest, against a young team with little at stake.
